Package com.vectorpeaks.backend.controller

Class BaseControllerTest

java.lang.Object
com.vectorpeaks.backend.controller.BaseControllerTest
@Import(TestSecurityConfig.class) public abstract class BaseControllerTest extends Object
Base class for all @WebMvcTest controller tests.

Provides:

  • TestSecurityConfig: disables CSRF and permits all requests,
  • Mocks for JWT security components to isolate web layer testing,
  • Bypass stubs for AccessInterceptor so it never blocks requests during tests – without these stubs every request would return 403 "Konto zostało zablokowane." because:
    1. MaintenanceService.isActive() defaults to false on a raw mock, which is correct – but stubbed explicitly for clarity,
    2. UserRepository.findById(principalId) defaults to Optional.empty() on a raw mock, causing the interceptor to treat every user as blocked.

Individual test classes may still declare their own @MockitoBean fields for MaintenanceService and UserRepository when their controller uses them directly. Because @MockitoBean beans are shared across the test context for the same controller slice, the stubs set here in @BeforeEach will apply to those shared instances automatically.
